chunks: Hafs narrated from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He makes up the prayer of one day.

key_terms.يَقْضِي: He makes up / fulfills the missed obligation

ai.seo_question: How many prayers must be made up by someone who was unconscious for a day?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this concise narration from Imam al-Sadi‘ (AS) establishing that a person who loses consciousness for a full day is not required to make up the prayers missed during that period. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle that the obligation of Salah is suspended (*mu‘allaq*) during states of unconsciousness, distinguishing it from sleep where prayers are also not made up, thereby emphasizing the continuity of duty only upon full recovery of consciousness.
